title: Spec: node class encoding in CCP capability announcement
description: Add to spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md: define how node class is announced in CCP. Propose 2-bit field in existing CCP capability structure: 00=leaf, 01=router, 10=relay, 11=gateway. Neighbors use this to make forwarding decisions (prefer relay over router as next hop when equal). Cross-reference spec/08-nodes.md for class definitions. Verify: markdown renders, no conflicts with existing CCP fields.
